# sample_sample (Resource)

Basic resource that does nothing other than interact with the Terraform state

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sample_sample" "example" {
  string = "Example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `string` (String) A simple string

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String) Resource update date in RFC850 format
- `result` (String) Concatenation of provider.prefix, provider.delimiter and the resource string
